Enforce encapsulation boundaries using the 4 Java access modifiers
Apply industry-standard reverse-domain naming conventions

lessons.title: Why Packages?
lessons.summary: Understand packages as folder namespaces that prevent class naming collisions and group related classes together.
learningOutcomes: Explain why enterprise codebases require packages
Map package declarations to computer directory structures

lessons.title: Creating & Using Packages
lessons.summary: Declare packages using the package keyword as the first line of code, and compile multi-package Java source files.
subtopics: Running Packaged Classes with java package.ClassName
learningOutcomes: Declare packages in Java source files
Compile and run packaged classes from the command line

lessons.title: import & Fully Qualified Names
lessons.summary: Bring external classes into scope with import statements, resolve name conflicts using fully qualified names, and use static imports.
learningOutcomes: Import classes cleanly without polluting namespaces
Resolve duplicate class name collisions using fully qualified names

lessons.title: Access Modifiers Overview
lessons.summary: Master the 4 levels of Java visibility: public, protected, default (package-private), and private.
subtopics: Class Level vs Member Level Visibility
learningOutcomes: Recite and apply the 4-level visibility matrix
Select the most restrictive suitable access level

lessons.title: public, private & package-private
lessons.summary: Deep dive into the 3 most common modifiers: private data hiding, package-private default visibility, and public universal access.
learningOutcomes: Protect internal data state with private fields
Provide controlled public accessors

lessons.title: protected & Cross-Package Access
lessons.summary: Understand protected visibility: accessible within the same package and to subclasses in different packages through inheritance.
subtopics: Same-Package Access vs Cross-Package Subclass Access
learningOutcomes: Explain how protected differs from package-private default access
Use protected for extensible base framework classes

lessons.title: Naming & Project Organization
lessons.summary: Follow global industry standards: reverse-domain naming (com.company.project.module) and standard enterprise directory layouts.
learningOutcomes: Name packages following Oracle and Maven conventions
Structure real-world enterprise multi-package repositories

lessons.title: Packages — Practice & Interview Challenge
lessons.summary: Refactor a monolithic banking script into a clean, encapsulated multi-package architecture with service, model, and utility layers.
learningOutcomes: Decompose monolithic applications into multi-package architecture
Demonstrate mastery of Java access boundaries

modules.title: Java Basics Mini Projects
modules.description: Synthesize all Java basics in 6 comprehensive, end-to-end interactive console applications.
learningObjectives: Synthesize variables, data types, operators, I/O, conditionals, loops, methods, arrays, strings, and exceptions into working systems
Build complete, interactive, resilient console applications from scratch
Follow clean code architecture, defensive programming, and user-friendly UX standards
Prepare portfolio-ready Java CLI projects for placement interviews

lessons.title: Console Scientific Calculator
lessons.summary: Build an interactive multi-operation console calculator supporting arithmetic, powers, square roots, and input validation.
learningOutcomes: Synthesize operators, loops, and Scanner input into a working tool
Handle mathematical edge cases gracefully

lessons.title: Number Guessing Game
lessons.summary: Develop a classic number guessing game with random number generation, dynamic higher/lower hints, and a limited attempt counter.
learningOutcomes: Manage interactive game loops with dynamic state
Provide helpful user feedback on each iteration

lessons.title: Student Marks Analyzer
lessons.summary: Build a classroom grade reporting tool: accept student names and scores into arrays, calculate class averages, and identify top performers.
learningOutcomes: Process and aggregate batch data using arrays
Generate clean tabular console output using printf

lessons.title: ATM Console Application
lessons.summary: Implement an interactive ATM simulator featuring secure PIN authentication, balance queries, cash deposits, and withdrawal limit validation.
learningOutcomes: Enforce real-world financial validation rules
Maintain state across multi-step user sessions

lessons.title: E-Commerce Billing & Discount System
lessons.summary: Create a supermarket billing checkout engine: scan item codes, apply tiered percentage discounts, calculate sales tax, and print receipts.
learningOutcomes: Implement complex multi-tier business calculations
Format professional invoices and receipts

lessons.title: Capstone: Employee Management & Payroll System
lessons.summary: Comprehensive Java Basics Capstone: manage employee records, calculate net salaries with tax deductions, search records, and handle invalid inputs.
learningOutcomes: Deliver a comprehensive, portfolio-ready Java CLI application
Demonstrate total mastery of Java Basics programming
